description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

BAE Systems is hiring a Software Engineer I to build interactive software platforms for internal business needs, including Facilities and Plant Operations, marketing, and aerospace programs. The role focuses on virtual, augmented, and mixed reality experiences, software development, and integrating AI tools.
Software Engineer I developing VR/AR/MR interactive platforms with Unity/.NET and integrating AI tools for internal business programs

Responsibilities:
• Develop Interactive Platforms: Design and build visual, interactive experiences—specifically leveraging virtual, augmented, or mixed reality—to support internal business needs
• Engineer Software Solutions: Utilize game engines like Unity or software frameworks such as .NET to develop robust software services
• Drive AI Integration: Research, learn, and implement new AI tools to evolve the team's capabilities and deliver cutting-edge solutions to in-house clients
• Support various programs: Contribute technical expertise to a variety of projects, ranging from Facilities and Plant Operations to marketing and aerospace programs
• Maintain a regular and predictable work schedule
• Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Units, Strategic Capabilities Units and the Company. Interact appropriately with others in order to maintain a positive and productive work environment
• Perform other duties as necessary

Requirements:
• BS degree or higher in Engineering or a related technical field is required
• Each higher-level degree, i.e., Master's Degree or Ph.D., may substitute for two years of experience. Related technical experience may be considered in lieu of education. Degree must be from a university, college, or school which is accredited by an agency recognized by the US Secretary of Education, US Department of Education
• Experience developing VR/AR applications
• Experience working with Unity or Unreal Engine
• Programming experience with C#, C++ or Python
• Experience with 3D modeling or CAD, such Blender/3DS Max/Maya
• Experience with UI/UX design and testing
• Adobe Creative Suite experience with software such as Illustrator/Premiere/Photoshop
• A desire to learn
• Excellent work ethic
• Good interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a team and solo environment
• Passion for creativity, problem-solving, and troubleshooting

Preferred:
• Experience with generative AI prompt engineering
• Experience implementing or developing generative AI
• Experience integrating AI features in applications, e.g. using APIs, RAG/vector databases, running local models
• Experience with modern VR/AR SDKs such as OpenXR, WebXR, ARKit or ARCore
• Experience developing web applications
